subject: RE: [EXTERNAL] Encord
text:
Hi Laura,

Great! Glad to hear you can run air-gapped since that is a deal-breaker for us.

I am available next Tuesday morning.
Can you schedule a ½ hour meeting sometime between 8:00AM-11:00AM PST?

We are early on in the journey to digitize the inspection processes on our production floor.
Our interest is in anomaly detection, segmentation, and object detection for ceramic component manufacturing.
Inputs will be 2D digital images (.tiff) files from optical and acoustic imaging systems.
Non-conformance reports can be paired with images of defects.

Hopefully that provides you with some context of what we're trying to do.

Thanks,
Jesse
